name: Meeting notes
description: Each weekday evening: today's meeting notes filed, with decisions and who does what next.
instructions_md: Gather today's meeting notes from my notes app if one is connected (Fireflies, Granola or others), otherwise from today's calendar events and anything I sent you. For each meeting: a three-line summary, the decisions, and the action items with owners and dates. Save one Markdown file per meeting in shared/meetings/ and ask me before sending anything to anyone.
